title: Make the sprite editor open the whole sheet
ask: HQ's sprite editor opens the entity catalogue's preview frame list rather than the sheet — Chicken lists four of its eight cells, the farmer four of sixteen — so a hand edit silently touches part of a sheet without saying so. The editor should open every cell of a sheet, with the animating frames only highlighted as what animates.
first_action: Read hq/static/sprite.js and hq/data/entities.json, and confirm the frame-count mismatch on Chicken and Farmer before changing anything.
source_message: HQ's sprite editor opens the entity catalogue's preview frame list rather than the sheet — Chicken lists four of its eight cells, the farmer four of sixteen — so a hand edit silently touches part of a sheet without saying so. The editor should open every cell of a sheet, with the animating frames only highlighted as what animates.
result: This attempt did not finish — it used all the turns it was given, mid-edit. What it had already changed did land, and the check below is what the chief of staff made of it.

check.summary: The editor now opens every cell of a sheet with the animating cells marked, saves only cells actually painted on, and I confirmed the Chicken and Farmer mismatch from the catalogue myself since no reply came back; watch the red "not listed" tag, which paints designed cells as if they were a problem.

findings.what: Cells the catalogue's preview list omits by design (Farmer's other 12 direction cells, Chicken's left-facing walk in cells 4–7, Crow's perched cell 8) are tagged "not listed" in red, so the map reads as broken on the very sheets the item was about
findings.fix: Use a neutral colour for unlisted-but-inked cells, and let entities.json carry a per-sheet cell inventory so the map can label them ("Farmer, walking up, frame 2") instead of "row 2, column 1"

findings.what: No reply came back, so the required confirmation step has no record and the change was not exercised in a browser
findings.fix: Open Chicken, Farmer, Sprinkler (shared objects sheet, straddled by the 16×32 cot) and Tilled Soil (64px cells on a 512×256 sheet) in HQ once before committing; the grid math checks out on paper for all four
